translations.web: “The bows of the mighty men are broken. Those who stumbled are armed with strength.
translations.bsb: The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble are equipped with strength.
translations.kjv: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.
translations.asv: The bows of the mighty men are broken; And they that stumbled are girded with strength.
